# Recorded walking foley

Eight individual real shoe-on-broken-glass steps by RileyB711 (CC0), replacing the synthetic glass layer. Six existing recorded concrete steps by florianreichelt (CC0), matched in level and softened above 6.5 kHz. No added glass smashing or synthesized crunch. Runtime randomly selects without immediate repeats, with small pitch variation. Source and exact processing: sources.json.

Downloaded high-quality MP3 previews from Freesound; WAV derivatives do not recover the original recording resolution. Headphone and actual headset listening review still required.
